name: Ear Ring
overview: Scripture references earrings primarily as valuable gold ornaments that were both worn and offered to the Lord, as seen in Exodus 35:22 where willing hearts brought gold earrings as offerings for the tabernacle. However, earrings also appear in contexts of idolatry, notably in Exodus 32 where the Israelites removed their golden earrings to fashion the golden calf, highlighting the misuse of these precious items for sinful purposes. Additionally, Genesis 35:4 records earrings associated with strange gods, further emphasizing their connection to idolatry. Proverbs 25:12 uses the imagery of a gold earring to illustrate the beauty and value of wise correction received by an obedient ear, showing a positive spiritual metaphor tied to these ornaments.
